info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Current Account Balance Inquiry API
info.description: The Current Account Balance Inquiry API allows users to access real-time balance information for specific current accounts. Financial institutions and banking applications can utilize this endpoint to enhance user experience by providing account holders with instant visibility into their account statuses. This API facilitates the retrieval of crucial banking details, enabling customers to manage their finances effectively. Typical consumers include banking apps, financial dashboards, and customer service portals needing up-to-date account information.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the details of a specific current account in the deposit lending system identified by the account number ACC-200045. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to access this information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details of the current account with the specified account number. The request must include the necessary authentication and any required parameters to successfully fetch the relevant account information.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current account details.

GetCurrentAccountDepositLendingRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the current account.

productCode.description: Code representing the product associated with the account.

principal.description: Details of the principal amount for the account.

termMonths.description: Term of the account in months.

repaymentFrequency.description: Frequency of repayments for the account.

accountPurpose.description: The purpose of opening the account.

statementFrequency.description: Frequency at which statements are issued.

overdraftAllowed.description: Indicates if overdraft is allowed on the account.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the account record.

version.description: Version number of the account record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the account was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the account response.

GetCurrentAccountDepositLendingResponse_.description: Response schema for fetching current account details.

currency.description: The currency of the principal amount.

Principal.description: Schema representing the principal amount and its currency.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the response was processed.

Metadata.description: Schema for metadata related to the account response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: Unique identifier for the endpoint being accessed. This helps in tracking and logging requests specific to a particular endpoint.

X-Runtime-App.description: Identifier for the application that made the request. This is useful for monitoring and identifying the source of the request within the architecture.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method with JSON Web Tokens (JWT). It allows clients to authenticate by including a token in the authorization header of their requests.
